title: Bioinformatics Engineer
description:
About NonStop: NonStop is a software services company at the intersection of bioinformatics, genomics, and healthcare technology. We partner with biotech firms, pharma organizations, genomics labs, and clinical institutions to design and deliver production-grade bioinformatics software, AI-powered analytical platforms, and end-to-end genomic data pipelines. We work on problems that matter: from accelerating variant interpretation workflows and building HIPAA-compliant AI platforms, to orchestrating large-scale multi-omics pipelines for disease diagnostics and pharmacogenomics. Our team blends deep domain expertise with engineering rigor, and were growing to meet the increasing demand from the life sciences industry for smart, scalable, and compliant bioinformatics solutions. 
 We work this way: We dig deep into biological problems, not just the code. Domain knowledge is valued as much as engineering craft. Bioinformatics is a team sport. Youll work alongside software engineers, clinicians, and research scientists. You own your work end-to-end, from design to delivery. We trust you to make good decisions and learn fast. Life sciences move fast. We encourage continuous learning, conference participation, and staying ahead of the field. 
 Your role: As a Bioinformatics Engineer at NonStop, you will be a key contributor in designing, building, and maintaining bioinformatics software solutions and analytical pipelines for our clients across genomics, clinical diagnostics, and precision medicine. Youll bring both biological insight and engineering excellence to every project, collaborating with product, engineering, and scientific teams to deliver solutions that are scalable, reproducible, and compliant. 
 You ll be responsible for: Build scalable bioinformatics applications and pipelines for efficient processing of genomic, transcriptomic, and multi-omics data. Produce high-quality, detailed documentation for all projects, pipelines, tools, APIs, and analytical methods. Provide technical consultation and solutions across cross-functional bioinformatics projects. Coach and mentor team members through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and pairing on domain-specific challenges. Ensure compliance with our SDLC process throughout the product development lifecycle. Stay current with evolving bioinformatics technologies and evangelize technical excellence within the team. 
 We re looking for: Preferably 1 year of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining bioinformatics solutions. Masters degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a closely related technical discipline. Strong understanding of genomic data analysis, variant calling, targeted sequencing, whole-exome (WES), and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) workflows. Hands-on experience with RNA-seq analysis, including differential expression and transcriptomic workflows. Proficiency in variant interpretation and ACMG/AMP classification workflows is a plus. Knowledge of algorithms and computational model development applied to biological data. Strong foundation in statistics and data analysis as applied to genomics and bioinformatics. Experience developing and debugging bioinformatics pipelines using Nextflow, Snakemake, WDL, or CWL. Proficiency in shell scripting and Linux/Unix environments for NGS data analysis. Familiarity with workflow automation and best practices in reproducible pipeline design. Excellent programming skills in Python (primary); familiarity with R or Java is a plus. Proficiency with standard bioinformatics tools (GATK, DeepVariant, VEP, ANNOVAR, MultiQC, FastQC, etc.). Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB). Confident use of Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development. Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS or GCP, or Azure) for bioinformatics workloads. Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments is a plus. 
 Why join NonStop: Work on real-world genomics and clinical bioinformatics problems that directly impact patient care and scientific discovery. Collaborate with life sciences clients at the cutting edge, from rare disease diagnostics to AI-assisted bioinformatics platforms.

title: Azure Data Architect
description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Architect with strong expertise in Azure data and analytics platforms. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and governing scalable cloud-native data architectures while enabling enterprise data, analytics, and reporting capabilities. 
 Role: Azure Data Architect Location: All Persistent Locations Experience: 10 to 15 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Design end-to-end Azure data architectures using services such as Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance, Cosmos DB, and Azure Data Lake. Implement data integration, migration, and transformation solutions using ETL/ELT methodologies. Collaborate with business stakeholders and Data Hub/Digital & AI teams to define data strategies and technical roadmaps Guide and mentor data engineers, analysts, and data scientists on architectural best practices. Work with DevOps teams to implement CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Azure Bicep) for automated deployments. Ensure compliance with security and governance requirements, including GDPR, HIPAA, UK data residency regulations, Key Vault, RBAC, and Private Endpoints. Establish and maintain data governance frameworks covering data quality, lineage, cataloguing, and compliance. Monitor and optimise data platforms for performance, scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency. Lead migration initiatives from legacy platforms to Azure cloud environments. Evaluate emerging technologies such as AI/ML and advanced analytics to drive innovation. Create architecture documents including HLDs, Technical Architecture Documents, Network Flow Diagrams, Environment Details, and Secret Inventory documentation. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 Strong expertise in Azure Synapse Analytics. Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF). Extensive experience with Azure Databricks. Strong knowledge of Azure SQL Database and Cosmos DB. Experience with Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake. Expertise in Azure Key Vault, Azure Relay, and Data Gateway. Knowledge of Azure IaaS services. Experience with Application Gateway and Azure Load Balancer. Familiarity with Azure Web Apps, Function Apps, Logic Apps, and Service Bus. Knowledge of Azure Machine Learning services. Strong proficiency in SQL and database development. Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation. Strong understanding of data modeling using star and snowflake schemas. Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices. Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor and operational monitoring frameworks. Experience with Power BI and enterprise analytics solutions. Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns. Excellent communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong strategic problem-solving abilities. Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams. Ability to provide architectural leadership and drive enterprise data transformation initiatives. 
 Benefits:

description:
Job Description On a day-to-day basis, this individual will be responsible for administrating and implementing database solutions while providing system operational support, administration, problem resolution, and perform software installations and upgrades on our database systems concentrating on Google Cloud Platform and other cloud-based solutions (up to 30%). The Database Administrator will be expected to exhibit strong troubleshooting techniques while striving to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Other duties also include monitoring performance and capacity on our database systems.

 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by: Responsibility for all enterprise database technology deployed in the cloud including various versions of Microsoft SQL Server and other database platforms including features such as the core database engine, reporting, data loading and transformations, business intelligence, replication technologies and other modules. Perform configuration and maintenance of database platforms, including patching. Monitor database instances for performance, utilization, and capacity. Work with application teams when appropriate to address issues. Manage maintenance plans, backups, and automated jobs. Responsible for the database platform security model, including using Active Directory-integrated accounts in a multi-forest environment where appropriate. Responsible for query writing and optimization. Responsible for database schema design. Develop, administer, and optimize Google BigQuery datasets, tables, views, partitioning, clustering, permissions, scheduled queries, and data pipelines to support reporting, analytics, and operational workloads. Responsible for advising report writers and their deployment in various reporting solutions or writing reports when needed. Support BigQuery SQL development, performance tuning, cost optimization, data governance, access controls, and integration with Google Cloud services, business intelligence tools, and enterprise data platforms. Use typical database, cloud, monitoring, and DevOps tools such as Google Cloud Console, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Dataflow, Dataproc, Looker, Tableau, SQL Server Management Studio, Visual Studio Code, Git, CI/CD release tools, PowerShell, Python, and ticketing or incident management platforms. Apply experience with AI agents and automation tools to improve database operations, including monitoring, incident triage, knowledge retrieval, documentation generation, operational workflows, and data-driven self-service capabilities. Responsible for performing traces and profiling to analyze and troubleshoot problems. Determine the best way to improve performance, whether through hardware adjustments, server configuration changes, or index and query changes. Understanding of software development methodologies, software development lifecycle management, and working in an Agile/SCRUM environment with software development teams, providing consultative advice on database design and query optimization, including indexes. Familiarity with DevOps tools for managing releases. Familiarity with code repository tools for managing SQL objects as code with version control. On-call support for after-hours issues required. Leverage automated alerting to be notified of issues as they happen. Tune alerts to reduce noise. Responds to incoming phone, email, or web-reported technical issues from internal users related to network and infrastructure, and assists in troubleshooting database issues as well as application issues for which the database may be a contributing factor. Identifies severity and impact and documents details in the Help Desk call tracking system. Performs database monitoring to ensure service level agreements are met and alerts appropriate IT staff and management of any downtime. Works in partnership with all IT teams to find solutions, and/or escalates issues to appropriate IT groups for resolution. Communicates status and updates to end users in a timely and consistent manner. Sets priorities for open issues and escalates issues to the correct department for resolution. Follows through with closure of user issues. Recreates problems in development environments for troubleshooting and resolution when needed. Creates and documents workarounds. Assist in training. Qualifications MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required. 7+ years of experience in database administration in a cloud-based enterprise environment, preferably across multiple versions of cloud providers using multiple database platforms. Administrative knowledge of Active Directory and other forms of database security Scripting and automation experience Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills Demonstrated strong customer service and analytic skills Demonstrated ability to think through sets of complex problems, create and implement appropriate solutions Proven ability to establish and maintain effective professional working relationships Ability to think and work independently Ability to adapt and learn in a fast-paced, changing environment. Administrative experience with at least one of Azure, Google Cloud, AWS Experience using or supporting AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions for database administration, cloud operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, or analytics use cases. Linux experience a plus. Administration experience in backup technologies that can be used to back up various database platforms. Additional experience in Disaster Recovery technologies a plus. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 10+ Years of experience preferred spanning more than one environment MongoDB and other non-Microsoft SQL Server database technologies a plus Data Warehousing experience a plus Hands-on Google Cloud database administration experience, including BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, IAM, performance tuning, cost optimization, and data governance. description:
Role Overview We are hiring a hands-on Senior Cloud Engineer to manage and optimize our multi-cloud infrastructure across AWS (primary) and Azure (secondary). This role requires a strong systems administration foundation, deep troubleshooting capability, and ownership of production environments. You will be responsible for maintaining system reliability, enforcing security best practices, optimizing cloud spend (FinOps), and strengthening monitoring and observability using Datadog. Required Qualifications 8-10 years of overall IT experience. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in both AWS and Azure. Strong Linux and Windows Server administration expertise. Solid experience with IAM, patch management, and cloud security policies. Proven experience with Datadog implementation and monitoring. Demonstrated FinOps and cloud cost optimization experience. Strong troubleshooting mindset with root cause analysis capability. Excellent verbal communication skills. Key Responsibilities Multi-Cloud Operations & System Administration Manage and support production workloads across AWS and Azure. Administer Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux) and Windows Server environments. Perform disk management, service configuration, user access control, and system hardening. Troubleshoot complex OS-level and infrastructure issues using logs and debugging tools. Work with AWS AMIs and Azure VM Images. FinOps & Cost Optimization Monitor and optimize cloud spend across AWS and Azure. Implement rightsizing strategies and eliminate unused resources. Manage Reserved Instances and Savings Plans. Use AWS Cost Explorer and Azure Cost Management to generate reports and insights. Drive tagging governance and budget enforcement practices. Security, IAM & Patch Management Manage IAM roles, security groups, and Azure NSGs following least-privilege principles. Own patch management lifecycle using: o AWS Systems Manager (SSM) o Azure Automation Update Management Ensure compliance with security policies and operational standards. Backup & Disaster Recovery Implement and validate backup strategies using: o AWS Backup o Azure Recovery Services Vault Support disaster recovery planning and testing. Ensure RPO/RTO compliance requirements are met. Monitoring & Observability Lead implementation and tuning of Datadog (agents, dashboards, monitors, APM). Reduce alert fatigue through intelligent monitoring configuration. Configure and maintain AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Nice to have Qualifications Scripting experience (Python, Bash, or PowerShell). Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM). Certifications such as: o AWS SysOps Administrator o Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) o FinOps Certified Practitioner What Success Looks Like You take ownership from issue identification to resolution. You proactively prevent outages rather than react to them. You balance performance, security, and cost efficiency. You communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders. You work independently and remain accountable.
